# doc-tools Architecture and AI Context

This repository provides a generalized, domain-agnostic document data ingestion pipeline built with Dagster.

## Core Purpose
Process generic documents (PDF, PPTX, DOCX) to extract rich text, metadata, and embedded images. Build a robust knowledge graph in Neo4j representing the semantic layout, vectorize the content into Weaviate for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and emit domain-specific RDF triples to Apache Jena. Specialized support is included for MIL-spec standards (S1000D, DITA, IADS, and MIL-STD-40051), converting them to formal RDF Knowledge Graphs using a unified MIL ontology.

## Architecture
- **Dependency Management**: `uv` powers all dependency resolution securely via `pyproject.toml`.
- **Orchestration**: `Dagster` orchestrates the pipeline, using generic dynamic partitions (`doc_id/filename`). Dynamic sensors map configured S3 prefixes, triggering `RunRequests` stamped with `domain_type` runtime tags to dynamically route document assets.
- **Config-Driven Domain Mapping**: Uses **Declarative Components** (`S3ToFileComponent`, `S3SensorComponent`) in `doc_tools/definitions.py` to instantiate jobs and sensors. These components encapsulate `IngestionConfig` (labels, collections) and replace the legacy `config.yaml`, keeping the underlying code strictly domain-agnostic.
- **Deployments**: Containerized CI/CD is managed via standard **Dockerfiles** in `.github/workflows/build-container.yml`. System dependencies for unstructured optical parsing (`libmagic1`, `poppler-utils`, `tesseract-ocr`) are installed via `apt-get` in the Dockerfile.
- **K8s Resource Control**: Uses `dag_tools.utils.k8s.resolve_k8s_resource_tags` for dynamic pod scaling. Prefixes include `DOC_PARSER`, `XML_INGEST`, `METADATA_INGEST`, `ONTOLOGY_INGEST`, and `DESIGN_PARSER`. Each prefix supports `_CPU_REQUEST`, `_MEM_REQUEST`, `_CPU_LIMIT`, and `_MEM_LIMIT` environment variables.

## Key Files & Directories
- `doc_tools/assets/ingestion_assets.py`: Layout detection, unstructuring, and intermediate manifest generation. Custom python-pptx extraction is layered here inside.
- `doc_tools/plugins/manufacturing_overlay.py`: Data-driven **overlay** for the manufacturing extractor. Splits `ManufacturingStep` into a public base and overlay fields that each declare extraction (BAML description) + persistence (`neo4j_attr` / `related` node+edge / `rdf_literal` / `rdf_relation`). A default (public) overlay is committed; a **proprietary** overlay loads from the `MANUFACTURING_OVERLAY_SPEC` secret JSON and is injected onto the `@@dynamic` `ManufacturingStep` via `TypeBuilder` — proprietary field names never enter the repo. Sample: `examples/manufacturing_overlay.sample.json`.
- `doc_tools/plugins/`: Contains the **Domain-Agnostic Plugin Architecture**. Base structural nodes are passed here where domain logic invokes BAML LLM schemas (e.g. `Training` and `Sustainment` obsolescence notices using full-document context aggregation, advanced factory physics via strictly separated `Manufacturing` constraints, `Maintenance` MRO procedures, and rigorous `Compliance` directives) and returns Cypher/SPARQL queries. Plugins emit `Figure` nodes linked via `REFERENCES_FIGURE` relationships for steps that reference diagrams.
- `baml_src/`: LLM prompt definitions mapped to structural schemas with strictly enforced Chain-of-Thought Guardrails. Compiles via `baml-py` into Pydantic models natively inside the Dagster workspace at `doc_tools/baml_client`. For dynamic enums (`@@dynamic`), always use the `TypeBuilder` pattern to register values at runtime.
  - **BAML Best Practices**: To mitigate recency bias, structure prompts with the Role definition first, followed by the `### DOCUMENT TEXT ###`, and then the `### INSTRUCTIONS ###` and `### OUTPUT FORMAT ###`.
- **prompts/**: Ground-truth, git-committed Markdown prompts (decoupled from BAML). These are the **canonical production source**. Prompt sourcing is env-controlled in `doc_tools/plugins/base.py::_get_dynamic_prompt`: `PROMPT_SOURCE=file` (default) loads these files with no Langfuse runtime dependency; `PROMPT_SOURCE=langfuse` is the opt-in SME/dev path that fetches live from Langfuse at `LANGFUSE_PROMPT_LABEL` (default `production`) with file fallback.
- `doc_tools/sensors.py`: Factory definitions routing Event-driven workflow hooks.
- `doc_tools/assets/semantic_assets.py`: Cypher logic for Neo4j Knowledge Graphs, semantic vectorization into Weaviate, and generic Hybrid Graph synchronization (Jena/Neo4j). High-performance in-memory RDF passing. Implements O(1) idempotent revisioning using Named Graphs and HTTP PUT. Post-sync domain labeling applies `:MAINTENANCE` to all XML-parsed nodes imported via n10s.
- `doc_tools/assets/xml_ingestion.py`: Universal XML extractor using MinioResource, routing to specialized parsers (S1000D, DITA, IADS, 40051) based on directory prefixes. Returns document metadata dictionaries for surgical revisioning.
- `doc_tools/assets/dds_ingestion.py` & `doc_tools/assets/rabbitmq_ingestion.py`: Git-native schema ingestion assets that dynamically clone OMG DDS `.idl` and RabbitMQ `.json` schema repositories into ephemeral temp directories, parse them using AST/recursive strategies, and emit them to DataHub to build end-to-end lineage graphs across the Redpanda/Kafka execution engine.
- `doc_tools/assets/global_semantic_ingestion.py`: The central authority for the **Semantic Binding Plane**. It implements a "Late Binding" architecture by polling DataHub for any dataset (dbt, legacy, etc.) tagged with an `ontology_uri` custom property and proposing standardized Phase 7 Glossary Terms.
- `doc_tools/assets/semantic_linker.py`: Standardized workflow for proposing and syncing semantic links. Refined for Phase 7 URNs (`urn:li:glossaryTerm:ShortName`) and dynamic URI resolution via DataHub GMS. Also hosts `apply_semantic_tags`, which merges the legacy DB/design extractors below, classifies each table via the Ontology Service `/classify_legacy_table`, and auto-tags at confidence `>= 0.85`.
- `doc_tools/components/oracle_extractor.py` & `doc_tools/components/sqlserver_extractor.py`: Declarative Components that extract table-level metadata from **live legacy databases** — Oracle (`ALL_TAB_COMMENTS` via `oracledb`, asset `extract_oracle_metadata`) and SQL Server (`MS_Description` extended properties via SQLAlchemy/`pyodbc`, asset `extract_sqlserver_metadata`). Both emit the uniform `{"schema.table": {"description", "domain"}}` contract.
- `doc_tools/components/design_parser.py`: Declarative Component (asset `parse_design_metadata`) that parses **data-modelling tool exports** from S3 — `.edmx` (.NET Entity Framework conceptual model: `EntityType`/`NavigationProperty`/`Documentation`) and `.json` (toolchain exports: `tables[]` with `name`/`description`/`relations`). Fed by the `design_sensor` watching `DESIGN_BUCKET` (default `design-artifacts`); domain is inferred from the S3 key prefix. Runs under the `DESIGN_PARSER` K8s prefix.
- `doc_tools/parsers/`: Specialized builders for MIL-spec standards (`s1000d_rdf.py`, `dita_rdf.py`, `iads_rdf.py`, `mil_std_40051_rdf.py`). All parsers extract `mil:Figure` triples from format-specific tags (`<figure>`, `<graphic boardno>`, `<graphic infoEntityIdent>`, `<fig>`, `<image>`).
- `doc_tools/definitions.py`: Entrypoint for Dagster binding assets. It uses a **declarative component model** via `dag-tools` to instantiate sensors and ingestion jobs, replacing the legacy `config.yaml`.
- `scripts/check_drift.py`: CI/CD GitOps gate that fails the merge if any `prompts/*.md` file diverges from the Langfuse version at `LANGFUSE_PROMPT_LABEL` (default `production`) — the same label the runtime serves, so CI guards exactly what the live path can serve.
- `setup/*.ttl`: Custom TBox extensions (mro_extension, mil_extension, idp_extension, mesh_system, maintenance_extension, sustainment_extension) consumed by the substrate-priming pipeline. Served via `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/edgy-solutions/doc-tools/main/setup/<name>.ttl` URLs. Substrate priming itself (Weaviate schemas, Neo4j constraints, Jena dataset provisioning, IOF/ISA95 ingestion) is owned by `invincible-agent/setup/prime_databases.py`, invoked via the invincible-agent chart's `primeSubstrate` Helm Job. The historical `setup/setup_env.py` was retired 2026-06-17. Do not modify databases manually; do not add a doc-tools-side priming script.
- `pyproject.toml`: The root configuration of Python parameters.

## AI Instructions
- All code MUST remain domain-agnostic. Do NOT hardcode domain references (e.g., "Course", "Slide").
- Always use the `uv` toolchain for dependency testing.
